Sumo

```{r}
## Sumo analytics starter — Kim style
## Packages & options
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

required_pkgs <- c("tidyverse","lubridate","gt","ggplot2","dplyr")
to_install <- setdiff(required_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install)
invisible(lapply(required_pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))

## Paths (edit as needed)
data_dir <- "data"

## Read tables (tabular CSVs)
tournaments <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "tournaments.csv"))
wrestlers   <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "wrestlers.csv"))
stables     <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "stables.csv"))
rankings    <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "rankings.csv"))
bouts       <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "bouts.csv"))
kimarite    <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "kimarite.csv"))

## Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Title + source for gt tables
tbl_title   <- "Sumo Snapshot"
tbl_source  <- paste0("Source: Sumo DB (compiled), date: ", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"))

## Bar chart aesthetics per Kim
bar_fill_1 <- "cornsilk3"
bar_fill_2 <- "darkgoldenrod2"
bar_fill_3 <- "lightsalmon2"
plot_bg    <- "darkslategray3"

theme_kim_bar <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = plot_bg, colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)
    )
}

## Derivations -----------------------------------------------------------

## Join for convenience
bouts_long <- bouts |>
  left_join(wrestlers |> select(rikishi_id, shikona, heya_id), by = c("east_id" = "rikishi_id")) |>
  rename(east_shikona = shikona, east_heya = heya_id) |>
  left_join(wrestlers |> select(rikishi_id, shikona, heya_id), by = c("west_id" = "rikishi_id")) |>
  rename(west_shikona = shikona, west_heya = heya_id) |>
  left_join(wrestlers |> select(rikishi_id, shikona), by = c("winner_id" = "rikishi_id")) |>
  rename(winner_shikona = shikona) |>
  left_join(stables, by = c("east_heya" = "heya_id")) |>
  rename(east_heya_name = heya_name) |>
  left_join(stables, by = c("west_heya" = "heya_id")) |>
  rename(west_heya_name = heya_name) |>
  left_join(kimarite, by = "kimarite")

## Utility: pick a tournament
pick_tourney <- function(year, basho){
  tournaments |>
    filter(year == {{year}}, basho == {{basho}}) |>
    slice(1) |>
    pull(tourney_id)
}

## Example views ---------------------------------------------------------

## 1) Kimarite profile for a tournament (stacked by family)
kimarite_profile <- function(tourney_id){
  
df <- bouts_long |>
  filter(tourney_id == {{tourney_id}}) |>
  count(kimarite, family, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(family = tidyr::replace_na(family, "other")) |>
  group_by(family) |>
  mutate(pct_in_family = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

df |> distinct(family) |> arrange(family)


## build a palette of the right length using your three standard colors
fam_levels <- unique(df$family)
base_cols  <- c(bar_fill_1, bar_fill_2, bar_fill_3)   # cornsilk3, darkgoldenrod2, lightsalmon2
pal        <- rep_len(base_cols, length(fam_levels))
names(pal) <- fam_levels

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(kimarite, n), y = n, fill = family)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Kimarite", y = "Count", title = "Kimarite usage (by family)") +
  theme_kim_bar()

  gt_tbl <- df |>
    arrange(desc(n)) |>
    mutate(pct_in_family = scales::percent(pct_in_family, accuracy = 0.1)) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = tbl_title) |>
    gt::tab_source_note(source_note = tbl_source) |>
    gt::opt_vertical_padding(scale = 0.7) |>
    gt::opt_row_striping() |>
    gt::cols_label(kimarite = "Kimarite", family = "Family", n = "Count", pct_in_family = "% within family")

  list(plot = p, table = gt_tbl)
}

## 2) Stable (heya) performance table for a tournament
heya_performance <- function(tourney_id){
  df <- bouts_long |>
    filter(tourney_id == {{tourney_id}}) |>
    mutate(winner_side = case_when(
      winner_id == east_id ~ "East",
      winner_id == west_id ~ "West",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(east_shikona, west_shikona, east_heya_name, west_heya_name, east_id, west_id),
      names_to = c(".value","side"),
      names_pattern = "(east|west)_(.*)"
    ) |>
    mutate(won = if_else(winner_side == str_to_title(side), 1L, 0L)) |>
    group_by(heya_name) |>
    summarise(bouts = n(), wins = sum(won, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(win_rate = wins / bouts)

  gt::gt(df |>
           arrange(desc(win_rate)) |>
           mutate(win_rate = scales::percent(win_rate, accuracy = 0.1))) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Heya performance this basho") |>
    gt::tab_source_note(source_note = tbl_source) |>
    gt::opt_vertical_padding(scale = 0.7) |>
    gt::opt_row_striping() |>
    gt::cols_label(heya_name = "Heya", bouts = "Bouts", wins = "Wins", win_rate = "Win rate")
}

## 3) Wrestler dashboard (per basho)
wrestler_dashboard <- function(tourney_id, rikishi){
  df <- bouts_long |>
    filter(tourney_id == {{tourney_id}}, east_shikona == rikishi | west_shikona == rikishi) |>
    mutate(opponent = if_else(east_shikona == rikishi, west_shikona, east_shikona),
           result   = if_else(winner_shikona == rikishi, "W", "L"))

  ## Summary table
  sum_tbl <- df |>
    count(result) |>
    complete(result = c("W","L"), fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    mutate(metric = if_else(result == "W","Wins","Losses")) |>
    select(metric, n)

  ## Kimarite bar
  kdf <- df |>
    filter(winner_shikona == rikishi) |>
    count(kimarite, sort = TRUE) |>
    mutate(kimarite = fct_lump_n(kimarite, n = 10))

  p <- ggplot(kdf, aes(x = reorder(kimarite, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = bar_fill_1, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "Kimarite (wins)", y = "Count", title = paste0("Winning kimarite: ", rikishi)) +
    theme_kim_bar()

  list(
    summary = gt::gt(sum_tbl) |>
      gt::tab_header(title = paste0("Dashboard — ", rikishi)) |>
      gt::tab_source_note(source_note = tbl_source) |>
      gt::opt_row_striping(),
    plot = p
  )
}

## Example usage (uncomment & set params)
 kyushu_2025 <- pick_tourney(2025, "Kyushu")
 out <- kimarite_profile(kyushu_2025); print(out$plot); print(out$table)
## heya_performance(kyushu_2025)
 wrestler_dashboard(kyushu_2025, "Hoshoryu")
 
 out
```

Upset analysis

```{r}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## San’yaku vs. Maegashira Upset Rate — early basho indicator
## ------------------------------------------------------------

sanmyaku_vs_maegashira_upsets <- function(tourney_id){
  ## Join necessary tables
  ranks <- rankings |> 
    select(tourney_id, rikishi_id, rank)
  
  df <- bouts |>
    filter(tourney_id == {{tourney_id}}) |>
    left_join(ranks, by = c("east_id" = "rikishi_id")) |>
    rename(east_rank = rank) |>
    left_join(ranks, by = c("west_id" = "rikishi_id")) |>
    rename(west_rank = rank) |>
    mutate(
      east_group = if_else(east_rank %in% c("Yokozuna","Ozeki","Sekiwake","Komusubi"),
                           "San'yaku","Maegashira"),
      west_group = if_else(west_rank %in% c("Yokozuna","Ozeki","Sekiwake","Komusubi"),
                           "San'yaku","Maegashira")
    ) |>
    filter(east_group != west_group) |>    ## Only cross-group bouts
    mutate(
      winner_group = case_when(
        winner_id == east_id ~ east_group,
        winner_id == west_id ~ west_group,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      upset = (winner_group == "Maegashira")
    )
  
  ## Summarize overall
  sum_df <- df |>
    summarise(
      bouts = n(),
      upsets = sum(upset, na.rm = TRUE),
      upset_rate = upsets / bouts
    )
  
  ## Optional day-by-day breakdown
  day_df <- df |>
    group_by(day) |>
    summarise(
      bouts = n(),
      upsets = sum(upset, na.rm = TRUE),
      upset_rate = upsets / bouts,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  ## Plot
  p <- ggplot(day_df, aes(x = day, y = upset_rate)) +
    geom_col(fill = "cornsilk3", color = "black") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = "San’yaku vs. Maegashira Upset Rate",
      subtitle = paste0("Tournament: ", tourney_id),
      x = "Day",
      y = "Upset rate"
    ) +
    theme_kim_bar()
  
  ## Table output
  gt_tbl <- day_df |>
    mutate(upset_rate = scales::percent(upset_rate, accuracy = 0.1)) |>
    gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Day-by-day upset rate") |>
    gt::tab_source_note(source_note = tbl_source) |>
    gt::opt_row_striping()
  
  list(summary = sum_df, plot = p, table = gt_tbl)
}
```

Get the past tournament data

```{r}
## ===========================================
## Sumo: build tournament_records.csv (last 5 basho)
## Source of results: SumoDB W/L Matrix (scgroup_matrix.aspx?b=YYYYMM)
## Outputs: tournament_records.csv (wide) keyed by rikishi_id
## ===========================================

## ---- Packages & options
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

req_pkgs <- c("tidyverse","rvest","stringi","lubridate")
to_install <- setdiff(req_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
invisible(lapply(req_pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))

## ---- Config
wrestlers_path <- "data/wrestlers_updated.csv"   ## must contain columns: rikishi_id, shikona
out_csv        <- "data/tournament_records.csv"

## ---- Helper: compute last 5 completed basho codes (YYYYMM)
## Uses standard basho months: Jan (01), Mar (03), May (05), Jul (07), Sep (09), Nov (11)
basho_months <- c(1,3,5,7,9)  ## exclude current/ongoing Nov for stability

last_five_basho <- function(ref_date = Sys.Date()) {
  yr  <- year(ref_date)
  ## We want the 5 finished tournaments just before (or equal to) ref_date's schedule point.
  ## If we're in Nov, "finished" set is Jan..Sep of this year; if earlier, roll back.
  sched <- tibble(
    y = yr,
    m = c(1,3,5,7,9,11),
    label = c("Hatsu","Haru","Natsu","Nagoya","Aki","Kyushu")
  )

  ## Keep only those strictly before the current tournament window
  now_m <- month(ref_date)
  finished <- if (now_m >= 11) {
    ## During Nov, treat Kyushu as ongoing; finished are Jan..Sep of this year
    sched %>% filter(m %in% c(1,3,5,7,9))
  } else if (now_m >= 9) {
    sched %>% filter(m %in% c(1,3,5,7))     ## up to Jul finished
  } else if (now_m >= 7) {
    sched %>% filter(m %in% c(1,3,5))       ## up to May finished
  } else if (now_m >= 5) {
    sched %>% filter(m %in% c(1,3))         ## up to Mar finished
  } else if (now_m >= 3) {
    sched %>% filter(m %in% c(1))           ## only Jan finished
  } else {
    ## Jan: use last year's Sep/Nov etc. Build a 6-basho rolling window and then pick last 5 finished.
    sched_prev <- tibble(
      y = yr - 1,
      m = c(1,3,5,7,9,11),
      label = c("Hatsu","Haru","Natsu","Nagoya","Aki","Kyushu")
    )
    bind_rows(sched_prev, sched) %>%
      arrange(y, m) %>%
      filter(y < yr | (y == yr & m < now_m)) %>%
      tail(5)
  }

  ## If fewer than 5 because of early-year timing, fill by rolling back into previous year:
  if (nrow(finished) < 5) {
    need <- 5 - nrow(finished)
    prev <- tibble(
      y = yr - 1,
      m = c(11,9,7,5,3,1)  ## reverse order for easy pick
    ) %>%
      head(need) %>%
      arrange(y, m) %>%
      mutate(label = case_when(
        m==1 ~ "Hatsu", m==3 ~ "Haru", m==5 ~ "Natsu",
        m==7 ~ "Nagoya", m==9 ~ "Aki", TRUE ~ "Kyushu"
      ))
    finished <- bind_rows(prev, finished)
  }

  finished %>%
    arrange(y, m) %>%
    tail(5) %>%
    mutate(basho_code = sprintf("%04d%02d", y, m)) %>%
    mutate(basho_label = factor(label, levels=c("Hatsu","Haru","Natsu","Nagoya","Aki","Kyushu")))
}

## ---- Helper: scrape one basho's Makuuchi W/L matrix
## Example URL: https://sumodb.sumogames.de/scgroup_matrix.aspx?b=202509
## Page lists each Makuuchi rikishi with a final record like "13-2" next to the name. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
## ---- Improved scraper: robust to Unicode dashes; tries table-first, then text fallback
scrape_basho_summary <- function(basho_code) {
  library(xml2); library(rvest); library(dplyr); library(stringr); library(stringi); library(purrr)

  url <- sprintf("https://sumodb.sumogames.de/scgroup_matrix.aspx?b=%s", basho_code)
  pg  <- read_html(url)

  # 1) Pick the large matrix table (many rows + many cells)
  pick_matrix_table <- function(doc) {
    tabs <- html_elements(doc, "table")
    if (!length(tabs)) return(NULL)
    score <- function(node) {
      n_tr  <- length(html_elements(node, xpath = ".//tr"))
      n_td  <- length(html_elements(node, xpath = ".//td|.//th"))
      txt   <- html_text2(node)
      # favor large, contentful tables
      n_tr + n_td + nchar(txt)/200
    }
    tabs[[which.max(vapply(tabs, score, numeric(1)))]]
  }

  mat <- pick_matrix_table(pg)
  if (is.null(mat)) return(tibble())

  # 2) Convert table to list-of-rows, each a character vector of cell texts
  trs <- html_elements(mat, xpath = ".//tr")
  if (!length(trs)) return(tibble())

  row_texts <- map(trs, function(tr) {
    cells <- html_elements(tr, xpath = ".//th|.//td")
    vals  <- html_text2(cells)
    vals  <- stri_trans_general(vals, "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII")
    trimws(vals)
  })

  # 3) Find the header row (contains "RANK" and "NAME" somewhere)
  is_header <- function(v) {
    any(str_detect(toupper(v), "\\bRANK\\b")) && any(str_detect(toupper(v), "\\bNAME\\b"))
  }
  hdr_idx <- which(vapply(row_texts, is_header, logical(1)))[1]
  if (is.na(hdr_idx)) hdr_idx <- 1  # fallback

  # 4) Parse data rows AFTER the header
  rank_token <- "^[YOSMKJ][0-9]+[ew]?$"  # Y/O/S/K/M/J, e.g., M2e, O1w, Y1e

  parse_line <- function(v) {
    v <- v[nzchar(v)]
    if (!length(v)) return(NULL)
    if (any(str_detect(toupper(v), "\\bRANK\\b")) && any(str_detect(toupper(v), "\\bNAME\\b"))) return(NULL)

    if (str_detect(v[1], "^[0-9]+$") && length(v) >= 5) {
      idx      <- v[1]; rank_val <- v[2]; name_val <- v[3]; prev_b <- v[4]; prev_r <- v[5]
    } else if (str_detect(v[1], rank_token) && length(v) >= 4) {
      idx      <- NA_character_; rank_val <- v[1]; name_val <- v[2]; prev_b <- v[3]; prev_r <- v[4]
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (!nzchar(name_val) || !str_detect(name_val, "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z\\-']+$")) return(NULL)

    rec <- str_replace_all(prev_b, "[^0-9\\-]", "")
    w   <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(rec, "^[0-9]+")))
    l   <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(rec, "(?<=-)[0-9]+")))

    tibble(
  index = suppressWarnings(as.integer(idx)),
  rank_str  = rank_val,            # <-- assign it, don’t leave `rank,`
  shikona = name_val,
  prev_basho = rec,
  prev_rank  = prev_r,
  wins = w,
  losses = l
)

  }

  bind_rows(lapply(row_texts[(hdr_idx+1):length(row_texts)], parse_line)) %>%
    mutate(basho_code = basho_code) %>%
    filter(!is.na(wins), !is.na(losses), nzchar(shikona)) %>%
    distinct(shikona, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

### End scraper

## ---- Pipeline
## 1) Load your wrestlers list (to define who we care about and to map to rikishi_id)
wrestlers <- readr::read_csv(wrestlers_path) %>%
  mutate(shikona_clean = stri_trans_general(shikona, "Latin-ASCII"))

## If you want to restrict to a subset (e.g., top 40 you maintain in this file), just keep as-is.

## 2) Determine last 5 completed basho (labels in chronological order)
basho_tbl <- last_five_basho()

## 3) Scrape each basho and combine
records_long <- purrr::map_dfr(basho_tbl$basho_code, scrape_basho_results)

## 4) Keep only wrestlers in your file, and join to get rikishi_id
records_long <- records_long %>%
  left_join(
    wrestlers %>% select(rikishi_id, shikona_clean),
    by = c("shikona" = "shikona_clean")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rikishi_id))

## 5) Attach basho labels for ordering
records_long <- records_long %>%
  left_join(basho_tbl %>% select(basho_code, basho_label), by = "basho_code") %>%
  arrange(basho_label)

## 6) Reshape to wide: basho1..basho5 wins/losses (oldest -> most recent)
## Ensure exactly five unique basho in order
b_labels <- basho_tbl %>% arrange(y, m) %>% pull(basho_label)
records_wide <- records_long %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(factor(basho_label, levels = b_labels))) %>%
  select(rikishi_id, idx, w, l) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = idx,
    values_from = c(w, l),
    names_glue = "basho{idx}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(rikishi_id)

## 7) Write CSV
readr::write_csv(records_wide, out_csv)

## ---- Done
message("Wrote: ", normalizePath(out_csv))

##### Sanity Test ##############

test <- scrape_basho_summary("202509")  # Aki 2025 example
print(head(test, 10))


```
Make the longer table with other basho

```{r}
records_long <- purrr::map_dfr(basho_tbl$basho_code, scrape_basho_summary)

# Join to your wrestlers file and pivot wide
library(readr); library(tidyr)
wrestlers <- read_csv("data/wrestlers_updated.csv") %>%
  mutate(shikona_clean = stringi::stri_trans_general(shikona, "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII"))

records_long <- records_long %>%
  mutate(shikona_clean = stringi::stri_trans_general(shikona, "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII")) %>%
  left_join(wrestlers %>% select(rikishi_id, shikona_clean), by = "shikona_clean")

# Order basho chronologically and assign indices 1..5
records_long <- records_long %>%
  left_join(basho_tbl %>% select(basho_code, y, m), by = "basho_code") %>%
  arrange(y, m) %>%
  mutate(bi = dense_rank(paste(y, m)))  # 1 oldest ... 5 most recent

tournament_records <- records_long %>%
  select(rikishi_id, bi, wins, losses) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = bi, values_from = c(wins, losses),
    names_glue = "basho{bi}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(rikishi_id)

readr::write_csv(tournament_records, "data/tournament_records_long.csv")

```

Check and fix

```{r}
## --- 0) Setup
library(tidyverse); library(stringi)

normalize_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stri_trans_general("Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>%
    tolower() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+","")        # drop spaces, hyphens, apostrophes
}

## You already have:
## - wrestlers_updated.csv (with rikishi_id, shikona)
## - basho_tbl (5 rows) from your earlier code
## - scrape_basho_summary() defined

## --- 1) Rebuild records_long (sanity)
records_long <- purrr::map_dfr(basho_tbl$basho_code, scrape_basho_summary)

cat("# rows from scraper: ", nrow(records_long), "\n")
print(head(records_long, 5))
summary(records_long$wins); summary(records_long$losses)

## Expect: >0 rows and nonzero wins/losses summaries

## --- 2) Check name matching BEFORE join
wrestlers <- readr::read_csv("data/wrestlers_updated.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(shikona_clean = normalize_name(shikona),
         rikishi_id    = as.character(rikishi_id))

scr_names <- records_long %>%
  mutate(shikona_clean = normalize_name(shikona)) %>%
  distinct(shikona, shikona_clean)

## How many match?
matches <- scr_names %>% inner_join(wrestlers %>% select(rikishi_id, shikona_clean), by="shikona_clean")
cat("Matched shikona count: ", nrow(matches), " / ", nrow(scr_names), "\n")

## What didn't match?
unmatched <- anti_join(scr_names, wrestlers %>% select(shikona_clean), by="shikona_clean")
if (nrow(unmatched)) {
  cat("Unmatched examples:\n"); print(head(unmatched, 10))
}

## --- 3) Build records_long with rikishi_id
records_long <- records_long %>%
  mutate(shikona_clean = normalize_name(shikona)) %>%
  left_join(wrestlers %>% select(rikishi_id, shikona_clean), by="shikona_clean")

## Diagnose join result
cat("rows after join: ", nrow(records_long), "\n")
cat("distinct rikishi_id (non-NA): ", n_distinct(na.omit(records_long$rikishi_id)), "\n")
print(records_long %>% filter(is.na(rikishi_id)) %>% distinct(shikona) %>% head(10))

## --- 4) Ensure basho indexing 1..5 is present
## (Your basho_tbl should have y, m; if not, add them the same way you built it earlier.)
stopifnot(all(c("basho_code","y","m") %in% names(basho_tbl)))

records_long <- records_long %>%
  left_join(basho_tbl %>% select(basho_code, y, m), by="basho_code") %>%
  arrange(y, m) %>%
  mutate(bi = dense_rank(paste(y, m)))   # 1 oldest ... 5 most recent

cat("basho index range: ", paste(range(records_long$bi, na.rm=TRUE), collapse=".."), "\n")
print(records_long %>% count(bi))

## --- 5) Final wide pivot (wins/losses)
tournament_records <- records_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(rikishi_id), !is.na(bi)) %>%
  select(rikishi_id, bi, wins, losses) %>%
  group_by(rikishi_id, bi) %>%
  summarise(wins = first(wins), losses = first(losses), .groups="drop") %>%  # in case of dup rows
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = bi, values_from = c(wins, losses),
    names_glue = "basho{bi}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(rikishi_id)

## Show a few rows to confirm values are there
print(tournament_records %>% slice_head(n=10))

## --- 6) Write CSV
readr::write_csv(tournament_records, "data/tournament_records_all.csv")
cat("Wrote tournament_records_all.csv with ", nrow(tournament_records), " rikishi.\n")

```
